title: Te Wairua i Muri i te Whakairo
intro: I raro i te atarangi o te wehenga nui mai i te mana whakahaere, i tatari tēnei tangata ngaro i te koraha. I a te rangatira o te iwi whiriwhiri e piki ana i te maunga tapu mō te komuniotanga atua, ka tau he whakamātautau nui ki te hunga i mahue. I whakamahia e tēnei tangata te wā ki te hanga anō i ngā whakapono o te hapori katoa. I te hokinga mai o te rangatira me te pono, ka whakaritea he whiu ahurei, mutunga kore. Ka taea e koe te wetewete ko wai tēnei wairua tautohenga, tinihanga hoki?
clues: I haere tahi māua ko tētahi iwi i wetekina i te ringa o tētahi kaitukino kaha nā roto i ngā tohu merekara.
I te pikinga o tō rātou rangatira ki te maunga ki te tiki arataki, i tatari ahau i roto i te hunga i noho ki muri.
I kohia e au he konganuku utu nui mai i ā rātou whakapaipai, ā, i hangaia hei mea e puta ai he oro.
Nā roto i tēnei hanganga, i whakatenatena ahau i tētahi whakatupuranga katoa kua kitea e rātou tō rātou atua i te koraha.
I te hokinga mai o te kaiārahi, ka tohua ko wai ahau, ka pātaihia he aha te mea i ārahi i ahau ki tēnei momo tinihanga.
Ko taku whiu i tēnei ao, kāore tetahi e pā mai ki ahau, kāore hoki e whakatata mai, he tohu whakama tēnei e mau tonu ana ki ahau.

options: Te Hāmiri

Ngā tohunga makutu a Parao
Hamana, minita a Parao

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Te hanga o te kuao kau koura
Te pakanga ki a Parao
Te hanganga o tētahi āka nui
Te korenga e piko ki mua i a Ātama
Te whakangaromanga o ngā pā o Ruta
trial.answer: Te hanga o te kuao kau koura

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: He whakapakoko kuao kau koura
He tokotoko i huri hei nakahi
He kamera uwha i puta mai i te toka
He āka i hangaia ki runga i te maunga
He torona e haria ana i runga i te hau

outcome.label: Hua
options: Kua whakahēngia kia kore e taea te pā atu, me te kī tonu 'kāore he whakapā atu'
I toremi i te taha o te kaitukino me tana ope taua
Maka ki roto i te ahi i whakamatao, i rangimārie hoki
I pāngia e te matapo mō te whakakahore i te pono
I whakarērea ki roto i te poka e te whanaunga hae
outcome.answer: Kua whakahēngia kia kore e taea te pā atu, me te kī tonu 'kāore he whakapā atu'

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
